note: Pinned so that implementing a recognition predicate cannot move it. Recognition may convert a deferral into PASS or PARTIAL and nothing else: the UNKNOWN set, the FAIL set, the NOT_APPLICABLE set and the penalty total of every product must be unchanged by it. A diff here is not a test to update -- it is a recognition predicate that has introduced absence, a defect, or a penalty.

No FAIL, NOT_APPLICABLE, or penalty total changed anywhere in the corpus.
